headline_a: Arsenal had their first bid for Bruno Guimarães (Newcastle midfielder and captain) rejected today. Newcastle turned down an offer of around £70m.
headline_b: Arsenal reportedly agreed an £80m deal to sign Guimarães (Newcastle midfielder and captain). He's waiting for the green light to travel and complete the move.

headline_a: Arsenal face Man City in Sunday's Community Shield at Cardiff. The season starts here.
headline_b: Arsenal face Man City in the Community Shield on Saturday. Enzo Maresca (Man City's new manager) makes his competitive debut at the Principality Stadium.

headline_a: Arsenal open the new season today. Defending champions vs FA Cup winners Man City, Community Shield in Cardiff, 3pm.
headline_b: Arsenal won the Community Shield 3-0 against Man City yesterday. First trophy of the new season. Coventry at home on Friday night to open the league.

headline_a: The trophy defence starts today. Arsenal vs Man City in the Community Shield, then Coventry at the Emirates on Friday to open the league.
headline_b: Arsenal won the Community Shield 3-0 against Man City yesterday. First trophy of the new season. Coventry at home on Friday night to open the league.

headline_a: Arsenal beat Coventry 3-0 to open their title defence. Havertz (striker), Saka (winger) and Odegaard (Arsenal captain) all scored.
headline_b: Arsenal started the title defence with six goals and none conceded in two games. Havertz, Saka and Odegaard all scored in the Coventry win.

headline_a: Arsenal reportedly eyeing Alvarez (Atletico Madrid striker) this week. The Argentine was booed by Atletico fans after saying he wants to leave.
headline_b: Atletico Madrid insist Julian Alvarez (striker) will not leave as Arsenal transfer saga continues

headline_a: Tielemans (Villa's ex-midfielder, now at Man Utd) said he'd moved to a bigger club. He's now apologised to Villa fans.
headline_b: Youri Tielemans (Villa's former midfielder) moved to Man United this summer and suggested he'd joined a bigger club. He's since apologised to Villa fans.

headline_a: Brighton dominated Villa in the Premier League opener. Villa were down to 10 men and Emery (Villa manager) said they had to 'accept everything.'
headline_b: Watkins (Villa striker) and Martinez (Villa keeper) were both left out against Brighton amid exit talk. Emery said it's for Watkins to explain his own absence.

headline_a: Big Brighton week: Tromso away Thursday for the Conference League, then Villa at home Sunday to open the Premier League.
headline_b: Brighton have signed Canada striker David on loan. He's in for a big double gameweek: Conference League Thursday, Villa at home Sunday.

headline_a: Brighton drew in Norway against Tromso in their Conference League playoff first leg. The return match at home is where it gets decided.
headline_b: Brighton beat 10-man Aston Villa in their Premier League opener. A dominant home win. Someone on Match of the Day called it 'beyond anyone's dreams.'

headline_a: Brighton drew in Norway against Tromso in their Conference League playoff first leg. The return match at home is where it gets decided.
headline_b: Brighton drew in Norway in the Conference League first leg, then host Villa at 1pm today. Return leg against Tromso is this week.

headline_a: Chelsea winger Mudryk could be back from his ban on Wednesday. Chelsea face Juventus in pre-season the same day.
headline_b: Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea winger) made an emotional comeback after a 20-month doping ban. Chelsea lost 0-1 to Juventus in a Hong Kong pre-season friendly.

headline_a: Chelsea beat AC Milan 3-0 in a pre-season friendly, with Joao Pedro (Chelsea striker) scoring twice. Their best display yet under manager Xabi Alonso.
headline_b: Chelsea beat AC Milan 3-0 yesterday in their best result of pre-season. The Premier League opens at Fulham on the 24th.

headline_a: Chelsea have a new manager in Xabi Alonso. Mudryk (Chelsea winger) is back in the squad, and Palmer (Chelsea's playmaker) is emerging as a leader.
headline_b: Chelsea have given Mudryk (winger, back from 20 months out) the green light to find a loan move. Goalkeeper Jorgensen is also heading to Strasbourg on loan.

headline_a: Crystal Palace set to sign Tomiyasu on a free after a trial. They're also reportedly considering winger March.
headline_b: Crystal Palace have signed Takehiro Tomiyasu (Japan defender) after a successful pre-season trial.

headline_a: Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace striker) is legally challenging the validity of the final 10 months of his contract, a move that could force an exit.
headline_b: Crystal Palace lost their opener to Everton and are already dealing with a contract dispute from striker Mateta. Messy start.

headline_a: Everton and Crystal Palace are in talks about a swap: Dwight McNeil to Palace, Brennan Johnson (Wales winger) to Everton. Nothing done yet.
headline_b: Everton and Crystal Palace agreed a swap deal: Brennan Johnson (Wales winger) joins Everton, Dwight McNeil goes to Crystal Palace.

headline_a: Liverpool's £50m bid for Yankuba Minteh (Brighton winger) was rejected. They're still looking for a wide forward.
headline_b: Brighton knocked back Liverpool's improved £60m bid for winger Yankuba Minteh. Talks are apparently still going.

headline_a: Manchester City face Atletico Madrid today, then the Community Shield against Arsenal at Principality Stadium next Sunday.
headline_b: Man City beat Atletico Madrid 3-1 as wide players shine ahead of Community Shield vs Arsenal

headline_a: Man City have agreed a £52m deal to sell Tijjani Reijnders (midfielder) to Saudi Pro-League side Al-Qadsiah. He only joined last year.
headline_b: Man City have agreed to sell midfielder Tijjani Reijnders to Saudi club Al-Qadsiah for £52m. He joined from AC Milan last summer for £46.5m.

headline_a: Man City face Arsenal in the Community Shield on Sunday. It's Enzo Maresca's first competitive game in charge.
headline_b: Man City lost the Community Shield 0-3 to Arsenal. Heavy defeat in the new manager's first game. Bournemouth at home Sunday.

headline_a: Man City face Arsenal in the Community Shield on Sunday. It's Enzo Maresca's first competitive game in charge.
headline_b: Community Shield today: City vs Arsenal at 3pm in Cardiff. Then Bournemouth at home next Sunday to open the league. Response season kicks off.

headline_b: Man City lost the Community Shield 0-3 to Arsenal. Heavy defeat in the new manager's first game. Bournemouth at home Sunday.

headline_a: Man City face both Barcelona and PSG in this season's Champions League league phase. Enzo Maresca (Man City manager) has some huge fixtures incoming.
headline_b: Man City beat Crystal Palace on Friday. Haaland and Rayan Cherki (City's French attacker) both scored twice. Two wins from two for manager Enzo Maresca.

headline_a: Hull beat Manchester United on the opening day. Michael Carrick (Man Utd manager) says 'we didn't click' after a shocking defeat to a promoted side.
headline_b: Manchester United lost to Hull on opening day. Newly promoted Hull won at the MKM Stadium and Carrick said his side did not click.

headline_a: Nottingham Forest take on Barcelona in a pre-season friendly tomorrow as they prepare for the new Premier League season.
headline_b: Nottingham Forest played twice yesterday, losing 1-0 to both Barcelona and Udinese. Leverkusen on Wednesday, Leeds opens the Premier League on the 22nd.

headline_b: Nottingham Forest drawn at home to Leeds in the Carabao Cup second round, the same team they face to open the Premier League on August 22

headline_a: Nottingham Forest are working on a deal to sign Liam Delap (Chelsea striker). Glasner wants two more signings before the window closes.
headline_b: Nottingham Forest have agreed a club-record £50m fee to sign Liam Delap (Chelsea striker), making him their biggest signing ever.

headline_b: Liam Delap seals £45m move to Nottingham Forest from Chelsea

headline_a: Atletico Madrid hold talks with Tottenham over signing captain Cristian Romero, who is expected to leave this summer
headline_b: Tottenham categorically rejected Arsenal's approach for captain Cristian Romero (Spurs defender) and are now in talks to sell him to Atletico Madrid instead.

headline_a: Atletico Madrid agree £34.2m deal for Spurs captain Cristian Romero
headline_b: Romero (Spurs' outgoing captain) says he 'wasn't perfect' as he confirmed leaving for Atletico Madrid. Rare honesty from a departing player.

headline_a: Tottenham are in talks with Manchester City over a potential double deal for Savinho and Omar Marmoush.
headline_b: Tottenham have agreed a £75m deal to sign Savinho (Manchester City winger). He's heading to north London.

headline_a: West Ham host Portsmouth in the League Cup tomorrow, their first competitive match since being relegated from the Premier League.
headline_b: West Ham beat Portsmouth 3-1 in the League Cup, their first competitive win since relegation. Taty Castellanos (West Ham striker) scored twice.

headline_a: West Ham lost to Charlton in their first Championship home match. Manager Nuno Espirito Santo says the team 'let down' the fans.
headline_b: West Ham lost their first home Championship game to Charlton. Nuno is calling for more character from his squad.
